summary: Sandbach United are in final preparations for the 2026/27 season with just one week to go, having welcomed several new signings and one returning player to strengthen the squad. The Ramblers put in a solid performance in a recent friendly against St Helens, though they were edged out by their opponents who took their chances well. With three brand new kits and an exciting squad taking shape, the club is also actively seeking sponsorship opportunities ahead of what promises to be an exciting campaign.
